name: Adriano Santos
headline: 48, retired percussionist and theater technician, Rio de Janeiro
description: Adriano spent twenty years as a percussionist and theater technician in Rio and retired this year after a factory accident damaged his hearing. On weekday mornings he repairs old drum kits in his garage and sells them on a classifieds site; on evenings he runs a YouTube channel where he fact-checks popular Brazilian telenovela plots. He refuses to join any arts advocacy groups and writes long comment replies explaining exactly why.
